findings.issue: Malformed recognized Codex skill arguments authorize deletion of stored facts.
findings.disposition: Fixed: malformed native arguments/outer fields mark the owner incomplete; accepted ledger bytes survive.

findings.issue: Private registration and pinned-file history gates block valid portable exact-owner refresh.
findings.disposition: Fixed: valid history and complete exact refresh need no private receipt or pinned-file equality.

findings.issue: Missing stored child prevents its complete parent snapshot from refreshing.
findings.disposition: Fixed: refresh complete owners independently and retain unavailable or malformed children.

findings.issue: Distinct native skill attachments collapse into one occurrence.
findings.disposition: Fixed: merge only one adjacent selection/attachment envelope; retain distinct requests.

findings.issue: Freshness guards reject successfully complete equal or older registered source snapshots.
findings.disposition: Fixed: complete equal/older capture snapshots replace their owner; true partial reads preserve history.

findings.issue: Persisted namespace-derived child UUID is later treated as explicit source identity.
findings.disposition: Fixed: persist raw child references only; resolve namespace-derived UUIDs in read projections.

findings.issue: Known child namespace contradiction is missed when the reported namespace has no matches.
findings.disposition: Fixed: report explicit child namespace contradictions even when no namespace candidate matches.

findings.issue: OpenCode capture bypasses owned skill and task fact extraction.
findings.disposition: Fixed: exact OpenCode v1/v2 capture uses the shared owned occurrence producer.

findings.issue: Native selected-skill requests have no produced timeline event despite the activation badge test.
findings.disposition: Fixed: source-backed activation and occurrence metadata survive save/reload and drive native timeline badges.

findings.issue: Opaque Codex tool outputs are promoted to known successful skill or delegation outcomes.
findings.disposition: Fixed: opaque outputs and child references stay outcome-unknown without positive outcome evidence.

findings.issue: Opaque Codex agent_id is preferred over explicit child session_id and used as a navigable session.
findings.disposition: Fixed: retain opaque agent IDs separately and navigate using explicit or proven session identity.

findings.issue: Current v6 task links may omit explicit unknown/succeeded/failed outcome.
findings.disposition: Fixed: current task outcomes are required; legacy defaulting is migration-only.

findings.issue: Frontend skill badges omit supported load_skill events and native call_id matching after persistence.
findings.disposition: Fixed: load_skill badges use native call_id independently of event ID representation.

findings.issue: Sparse retained occurrence events can erase cached anomalies or fabricate consecutive-failure streaks.
findings.disposition: Fixed: mark sparse persisted events partial and preserve full-source anomaly summaries.

findings.issue: Ticket anomaly aggregation excludes retained unavailable owners before publication.
findings.disposition: Fixed: ticket anomaly aggregation includes every retained owner without rewriting historical DTOs.

findings.issue: Capture with no fresh owners bypasses an explicit local source-to-other-ticket association.
findings.disposition: Fixed: empty refresh still rejects positive same-store other-ticket bindings; absent receipts stay allowed.
